outcome.answer: Lucie Flek is a coauthor of MiniFool, a physics-constraint-aware adversarial attack method for testing neural-network classifiers in particle and astroparticle physics [1]. MiniFool minimizes a cost combining a chi-squared-based test statistic, which reflects experimental uncertainties, with deviation from a target score; the paper applies it to IceCube-related use cases, MNIST, and CMS Open Data [1]. Flek is also a coauthor of a study using adversarially inspired perturbations consistent with experimental uncertainties to probe hidden sensitivities in high-energy-physics neural networks [8].
